_comment: The API's eligibility reasons per strategy (planning/selector.py) and its finding messages (planning/preflight.py) for each finding case - `others` are the plan's other selected VMs, `source_kind` the source provider's kind (openstack when not given), `holds_volumes` whether the migration holds the destination volumes an earlier attempt created (false when not given): test_selector.py and test_preflight.py run them against the API, mockData.test.ts against the dashboard's mock, which words them as the API does (SDD §9.2, §9.3, §16, review RV20-08). source/destination give a provider's capabilities and whether it has a conversion host, as provider_caps reads them. A network or GPU case gives `destination` - its label, kind, networks (id, name, mtu, project_id, own, shared, external), subnets, the token's roles and its policy profile, as the check reports them - and the plan its mappings, prestage_resources and nic_overrides (SDD §6.6, §7.3 step 0, §9.3, §21.5). A GPU case's `destination` also gives its flavors, the vGPU profiles it declares (`gpu_profiles`) and its GPU capacity, as its inventory reads them, and the plan its GPU mappings; `phases` gives the phase of the migration of a selected VM that has one, which its share is counted by (quota_share), `severities` and `remediations` a finding's own where they are not its catalog's, and an entry of `others` may give only the fields its count reads (SDD §9.3, §22.3, §22.5, plan task G12).
